reason: A sparkling cold-brewed mate in a slim can is exactly the kind of new thing I grab from a café fridge to try and post, so I'd buy one out of curiosity and maybe a second if it actually tastes good. Past that, it has to beat my usual coffee or matcha, and I'm not sure it will.
objection: 55 CZK is a lot for a can when an espresso or plain water does the job, and I can't tell yet if it tastes good or just looks good on Instagram.
would_change_my_mind: If the taste really surprised me, so it felt like a treat and not just a caffeine fix, I'd make it a regular thing rather than a one-off try.
